services.name: orbit-metrics-prometheus
services.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Metrics prometheus
After=docker.service network-online.target
Requires=docker.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker "container" "run" "--detach" "--pull=never" "--name" "orbit-metrics-prometheus" "--restart" "unless-stopped" "--network" "host" "--log-driver" "json-file" "--log-opt" "max-size=10m" "--log-opt" "max-file=3" "--label" "com.orbit.managed=metrics" "--label" "com.orbit.metrics.service=prometheus" "--label" "com.orbit.metrics.assignment=42" "--mount" "type=volume,source=orbit-metrics-prometheus-data,target=/prometheus" "--volume" "/etc/orbit/metrics/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro" "--health-cmd" "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:9090/-/ready" "--health-start-period" "30s" "--health-interval" "5s" "--health-retries" "12" "--label" "com.orbit.metrics.spec-hash=f5add5cf08566ac2a860180d10bc31192ec5cb2fce3722ed2f2f3092262ed4fc" "--" "prom/prometheus:v3.5.0" "--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml" "--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus" "--storage.tsdb.retention.time=7d" "--web.listen-address=127.0.0.1:9090"

services.name: orbit-metrics-grafana
services.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Metrics grafana
After=docker.service network-online.target
Requires=docker.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker "container" "run" "--detach" "--pull=never" "--name" "orbit-metrics-grafana" "--restart" "unless-stopped" "--network" "host" "--log-driver" "json-file" "--log-opt" "max-size=10m" "--log-opt" "max-file=3" "--label" "com.orbit.managed=metrics" "--label" "com.orbit.metrics.service=grafana" "--label" "com.orbit.metrics.assignment=42" "--mount" "type=volume,source=orbit-metrics-grafana-data,target=/var/lib/grafana" "--volume" "/etc/orbit/metrics/grafana/grafana.ini:/etc/grafana/grafana.ini:ro" "--volume" "/etc/orbit/metrics/grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro" "--volume" "/etc/orbit/metrics/grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro" "--volume" "/etc/orbit/metrics/grafana/admin-password:/run/orbit/grafana-admin-password:ro" "--env" "GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin" "--env" "GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD__FILE=/run/orbit/grafana-admin-password" "--env" "GF_SERVER_HTTP_ADDR=10.44.0.12" "--env" "GF_SERVER_HTTP_PORT=3000" "--health-cmd" "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://10.44.0.12:3000/api/health" "--health-start-period" "30s" "--health-interval" "5s" "--health-retries" "12" "--label" "com.orbit.metrics.spec-hash=c03d32f06c5c315b9841f6695a3628811ee6d03c225c8ad9e08dabc6aac4ef3e" "--" "grafana/grafana:12.1.1"
